title: Prism Theme Override
description: Sparse theme override applied on top of a registered theme. v2 expands typed nested blocks (mark, marks, axis, legend, title, view, range, schemes, style, states); legacy flat fields (background, font, font_size, color, palette, scheme, padding) remain for back-compat with v1 specs.

theme_override.description: Theme override block. All keys are optional; only present keys override defaults.

name.description: Name of a registered theme to inherit from (light, dark, print, high_contrast, colorblind).

background.description: Chart background color (legacy alias for view.background).

palette.description: Categorical color palette override (legacy alias for range.category.colors).

scheme.description: Named color scheme (legacy alias for range.category.scheme).

marks.description: Per-mark-type defaults keyed by mark type (bar, line, area, point, ...).

range.description: Default color schemes per scale role.

schemes.description: Per-theme custom named-scheme registry. Entries shadow the global catalogue.

style.description: Named-style registry. Marks reference an entry via the mark's style attr.

filters.description: Named registry of raw SVG <filter> inner-content bodies (e.g. a feGaussianBlur/feDropShadow chain), keyed by a theme-author-chosen name. Style blocks reference an entry via their own 'filter' property; a reference that does not resolve fails theme load with PRISM_THEME_FILTER_UNKNOWN. Escape hatch: this content is developer-authored and trusted the same as the rest of the theme/spec JSON — never route untrusted content through it.

raw_css.description: Raw CSS appended verbatim after the generated --prism-* variable declarations in the emitted <style> block. Same trust model as 'filters' — developer-authored, not sanitized.

gradients.description: Named registry of linear/radial gradient definitions. Style blocks reference an entry via a fill/stroke/background value written as url(#name); the SVG renderer emits a matching <linearGradient>/<radialGradient> def.

patterns.description: Named registry of pattern fills — either a built-in catalogue entry (diagonal-stripes, dots, cross-hatch, grid) or a raw-SVG 'content' body. Same url(#name) resolution/emission as 'gradients'.

line_height.description: Line height for multi-line text mark content.

letter_spacing.description: Letter spacing (tracking) applied to text mark content.

filter.description: Name of an entry in the theme's top-level 'filters' map.

label_line_height.description: Line height for axis tick label text.

label_letter_spacing.description: Letter spacing (tracking) for axis tick label text.

title_line_height.description: Line height for the axis title text.

title_letter_spacing.description: Letter spacing (tracking) for the axis title text.

filter.description: Name of an entry in the theme's top-level 'filters' map.

label_line_height.description: Line height for legend entry label text.

label_letter_spacing.description: Letter spacing (tracking) for legend entry label text.

title_line_height.description: Line height for the legend title text.

title_letter_spacing.description: Letter spacing (tracking) for the legend title text.

filter.description: Name of an entry in the theme's top-level 'filters' map.

line_height.description: Line height for multi-line chart title text.

letter_spacing.description: Letter spacing (tracking) for the chart title text.

scheme.description: Name of a registered color scheme.

colors.description: Inline color list (wins over scheme when both set).

type.description: Gradient shape. 'linear' uses angle; 'radial' uses cx/cy/radius.

angle.description: Linear gradient orientation in degrees (0 = left-to-right, clockwise). Ignored for radial.

cx.description: Radial gradient center x, as a fraction of the shape's bounding box. Ignored for linear.

cy.description: Radial gradient center y, as a fraction of the shape's bounding box. Ignored for linear.

radius.description: Radial gradient radius, as a fraction of the shape's bounding box. Ignored for linear.

stops.description: Color stops ordered by offset. At least 2 required.

type.description: Built-in pattern catalogue name. Omit when 'content' supplies a raw SVG pattern body instead — exactly one of 'type' or 'content' must be set.

color.description: Pattern foreground color (built-in catalogue types only).

spacing.description: Spacing between repeated pattern elements (built-in catalogue types only).

size.description: Size of each pattern element, e.g. dot radius or stripe width (built-in catalogue types only).

content.description: Raw SVG <pattern> inner-content body for a bespoke pattern. Same trust tier as the theme's top-level 'filters'/'raw_css' — developer-authored, never sanitized. Exactly one of 'type' or 'content' must be set.
